title: LambdaLens: Auditing a Representation-Changing Hyperparameter in Graph Neighbor Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Changing a graph embedding parameter can change what the layout represents. In SG-t-SNE-$\Pi$, the rescaling parameter $\lambda$ changes the probability assigned to each neighbor before optimization begins. We introduce LambdaLens to trace that change from individual edges to the resulting layout. For nodes with at least two neighbors, we derive a normalized power path. When the original weights are unequal, the number of neighbors determines where the weights become uniform and where their ordering reverses. Near $\lambda=1$, the rate of change in each edge probability depends on its surprisal relative to the neighborhood entropy. To measure the geometric effect, we vary $\lambda$ while holding the input graph, initialization, random seed, and optimizer settings fixed. Across six graphs, some layouts continue to move as $\lambda$ increases, others stabilize early, and others barely move. PubMed has the widest relative spread in node deg

translated_title: LambdaLens：审计图邻居嵌入中一个改变表示的超参数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.30140v1 公告类型：新 摘要：改变图嵌入的一个参数可能会改变布局所表示的内容。在 SG-t-SNE-Π 中，重缩放参数 λ 会在优化开始之前改变分配给每个邻居的概率。我们提出 LambdaLens 来追踪这一变化如何从单条边传递到最终生成的布局。对于至少拥有两个邻居的节点，我们推导出一条归一化幂路径。当原始权重不相等时，邻居数量决定了权重在哪里变为均匀、以及它们的排序在哪里发生反转。在 λ 接近 1 时，每条边概率的变化率取决于其相对于邻域熵的惊讶度（surprisal）。为了度量几何效应，我们在固定输入图、初始化、随机种子和优化器设置的前提下改变 λ。在六个图上的实验中，一些布局随 λ 增大而持续移动，另一些较早趋于稳定，还有一些几乎不动。其中 PubMed 在节点度方面表现出最宽的相对分布范围。
tldr: 提出 LambdaLens，从边级概率到最终布局对 SG-t-SNE-Π 图嵌入中的重缩放超参数 λ 进行理论推导与受控实验审计，揭示其如何改变邻居权重分布与嵌入几何结构。
en_tdlr: LambdaLens theoretically and empirically audits the rescaling hyperparameter λ in SG-t-SNE-Π graph embedding, tracing how it reshapes neighbor probabilities from individual edges to the resulting layout geometry.
